newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia slams Israeli blockade imposed on Palestinian people.
- Experts pool resources to help speed up Saudisation process in the private sector.
- Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Toyo Engineering Corp, and a U.S. firm jointly win an order to build a large petrochemical complex in Saudi Arabia.
- Construction sector plays an important role in the country's economy, second deputy prime minister says.
- Saudi Arabia beheads a Pakistani for smuggling drugs.
- A Saudi national pardons a Yemeni who killed his son shortly before his execution.
- Electricity Company of the Eastern province to undertake projects worth 72 million riyals to enhance its services.
